Gopala's Journey

Eighteen months, eighteen articles, one road: from an idea on a laptop to a model trained from scratch and products clients pay for. Each stop is one part of the series. Press play to watch Gopala walk it, or click any stop to see what happened there, which hats he wore, which layers of the AI factory were busy, and what went wrong. Gopala is a teaching scenario; story events are labelled as such.

Numbers come from the articles' scripts and cited sources; money spent, customers and incidents are the story's figures. Maestro Mission Control has the timeline, budget and risk register; the live system map shows the layers in more detail.
